statusLegend.real: Source/content and API or static implementation exist; live success is not implied.
statusLegend.partial: Some UI/service path exists, but full capability, external provider, or live behavior is incomplete or unverified.

statusLegend.broken: Use only when a reproducible failure is observed.
statusLegend.dead: Use for code/path with no reachable UI entry point.
